author: cellish
body:
We all know that this server is a great server, just struggling with bugs and shit. but anyways, I'd like to get some new things, and maybe some things to bring back.

1. Levels, maybe a little bit Mineplex or something, but I think that you could level up on the server before, bc I watched someone on outube with a pretty old video and he was like lvl 45 or something, overall I think this would be good to add just to make people want to play more because for example, if you level up to a specific level, you unlock new items to buy or something. 

2. Accesories, more accesories or whatevery you say should be added, for example badges, to just have more badges to unlock, and some other stuff. And. If i know right, you could have pets on this server a pretty while ago, couldn't you?
Overall I think that would be a great thing to add 

3. Colors for Badges, Colors for badges, where did they go?!?! Gray badges aren't really much nice looking just as you know... 

Thanks for reading xD Please give feedback!! :)

Badge colors will hopefully be coming back sooner rather than later.
